title.zh: 宣布每年6月21日为甲米地省Tagaytay市特别非工作日假期，以纪念其建市日，为此修订第10775号共和国法的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring June 21 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in Tagaytay City, Province of Cavite in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day to be Known as "Charter Day of Tagaytay City" or "Araw ng Lungsod ng Tagaytay", Amending for the Purpose Republic Act No. 10775
title.orig: An Act Declaring June 21 of Every Year a Special Nonworking Holiday in Tagaytay City, Province of Cavite in Commemoration of Its Foundation Day to be Known as "Charter Day of Tagaytay City" or "Araw ng Lungsod ng Tagaytay", Amending for the Purpose Republic Act No. 10775
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 21 tháng 6 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Thành phố Tagaytay, Tỉnh Cavite với tên gọi "Charter Day of Tagaytay City" hoặc "Araw ng Lungsod ng Tagaytay", nhân kỷ niệm Ngày Thành lập của địa phương
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 21 มิถุนายนของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในเมือง Tagaytay จังหวัด Cavite ในชื่อ "Charter Day of Tagaytay City" หรือ "Araw ng Lungsod ng Tagaytay" เนื่องในโอกาสวันสถาปนา
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 21 Juni setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Kota Tagaytay, Provinsi Cavite dengan nama "Charter Day of Tagaytay City" atau "Araw ng Lungsod ng Tagaytay", dalam rangka memperingati Hari Jadi
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 21 Jun setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Bandar Tagaytay, Wilayah Cavite dengan nama "Charter Day of Tagaytay City" atau "Araw ng Lungsod ng Tagaytay", sempena memperingati Hari Penubuhan

text.en:
Section of Republic Act No. 10775 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"

June 21 of every year is hereby declared as special nonworking holiday in Tagaytay City, Province of Cavite in commemoration of its foundation day to be known as "Charter Day of Tagaytay City" or "Araw ng Lungsod ng Tagaytay".
Section 2 of Republic Act No. 10775 is hereby repealed.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
